# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 13 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 13 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 13

**13:1** When she was in her sixth month, Joseph returned from his building work and came home to find her with child. He struck his face with his hand and threw himself to the ground on sackcloth and wept bitterly, saying: "With what face can I look toward the Lord God? What prayer am I to make concerning this young woman? I received her from the temple of the Lord God as a virgin, and I have not protected her. Who laid this snare for me? Who committed this wickedness in my house and violated her? Has the story of Adam been repeated in me? For as Adam was absent at the hour of his prayer and the serpent came and found Eve alone and deceived her — so also has it happened to me."

**13:2** Joseph rose up from the sackcloth and called Mary, saying: "You who were brought up in the Holy of Holies and fed from the hand of an angel — why have you done this? Why have you forgotten the Lord your God? Why have you humbled yourself in this way?"

**13:3** But Mary wept bitterly, saying: "I am pure. I have not known a man."

**13:4** Joseph said to her: "Then from where has come that which is in your womb?"

**13:5** She answered: "As the Lord my God lives, I do not know from where it came to me."
